comparison: Single saved transit100 episode vs single successful Astranomy direct retry; initial failed Astranomy attempt excluded from per-episode timing.
timing_definition: Control time excludes measured recording. Transit also adds its separate initial-plan model time for the inclusive model-work comparison; this does not include all initial local preparation. Wall-time comparison includes each native wrapper setup/recording/finalization.

method_differences.transit100: Initial plan plus multi-stage motion fragments, local execution and reused obstacle map; transit command cap 0.10m, target limit0.50m, contact cap0.005m.
method_differences.astranomy: One absolute target per response,1-5 native20Hz steps; target translation max0.05m, per-step command cap0.02m. Full accepted visual/text history and calibrated geometry.

caveats: One successful recorded episode per framework; different run times/server latency and controller settings, not a controlled causal ablation or success-rate estimate.

Raw LIBERO reached in both while yellow/white mug remained held/not settled; transit passed a separate38-action release/settle diagnostic excluded from policy action count, while Astranomy has not undergone that test.
Contact-point counts are repeated physics-substep samples, not independent collision-event counts or safety rankings.
Transit had no can contact but did have palm/object contact; it is not collision free.
No route-search/detour activated in this transit episode, so data do not establish A-star search as the cause of obstacle avoidance.
Fresh Astranomy002 is the successful retry; failed001 consumed34 calls and322.012s additional process wall time but is not included in these per-episode metrics.
